groups.basis: Both describe the same offer: Lady Hilda will join the dragon hunt for pay, adding a seasoned armored fighter. Both help thread_2, are established openings, and have the same trigger and benefit.
groups.text: Hire Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter in chain mail and shield who is staying at the Clumsy Fox, to join the dragon hunt. Her fee is not yet set.

groups.basis: Both describe the same action: retrieving the magic sword buried with Brandon at the Barrow. Both give the same benefit, citing Father William's claim that it is the only weapon that can kill the dragon. Both help thread_2, are established, and carry the same caveat from George about the legend.
groups.text: Walk about three miles through the forest to Brandon's Barrow Mound and recover the magic sword buried with Brandon. Father William says the dragon can't be killed without it, though George says no one knows what is true of the legend.

groups.basis: Both describe the same plan: give Warwick the sleeping potion Ingrid is brewing so he stays asleep while Dunk goes after the mithril shirt in his shop-home. Both help thread_10, are established, and share the same resource and caveats about the unfinished, diluted potion.
groups.text: Collect the sleeping potion Ingrid is brewing from the diluted faun wine and help her give it to Warwick, so Dunk can enter his house and shop for the mithril shirt without Warwick waking. The potion isn't finished, and its strength is unproven because the faun wine was heavily diluted.
